name: Abdulkader Alturkmani
intro: I’m Abdulkader, a University of Toronto student interested in how software and data help us understand the world around us.
about_intro: I study Geospatial Data Science at the University of Toronto, with minors in Applied Statistics and Computer Science. I like work that connects data to something tangible: a landscape, a visual interface, or a small game you can actually play.

experience.title: Frontend Web Design Intern
experience.description: I worked on a header redesign and layout restructuring, using engagement research to guide the design. Keyword and competitor analysis informed SEO and AEO recommendations, and I collaborated asynchronously through feedback and design revisions.

certifications.name: CS50P — Introduction to Programming with Python

skills.detail: ArcGIS Pro, ModelBuilder, viewsheds, least-cost paths, and terrain analysis.
Python, Java, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS; tree structures and recursion.
pandas, NumPy, descriptive statistics, regression, and Excel.
Matplotlib, Seaborn, JavaFX, WordPress, Elementor, and Figma.

projects.title: Viewshed & Hiking Route Analysis
projects.description: Which viewpoint offers the widest view, and how do you route a hike around a trail closure? I compared three viewpoints in Pipestone Valley with geodesic viewsheds; the selected site covered 153.14 km² of visible terrain.
projects.detail: A ModelBuilder workflow weighted slope and landcover costs equally to generate a least-cost route. Tobler’s Hiking Function estimated walking speeds, with maps comparing visibility, terrain costs, and the proposed route.

projects.title: Treemap Filesystem Visualizer
projects.description: A filesystem explored through rectangles. Nested directories are represented as a tree, preserving parent–child relationships and file sizes.
projects.detail: Recursive rectangle subdivision allocates screen space by subtree size, making large files and folders easy to compare.

projects.title: Java Paint with AI Integration
projects.description: A drawing application for creating and editing geometric shapes, with custom colours and stroke widths.
projects.detail: Undo, redo, and clipboard operations let users revise drawings and reuse shapes. The Ollama API supports prompt-based image generation and editing within the interface.

projects.title: Othello Game AI
projects.description: An 8×8 Othello engine with turn management, move validation, token counting, and winner detection.
projects.detail: A greedy controller evaluates directional flips to choose moves, alongside human and random AI controllers for different matchups.

projects.title: CS50 Memory Card Game
projects.description: A memory game built around shuffled pairs of letters. Choose a difficulty or a custom grid, uncover two cells at a time, and find every match.
projects.detail: Originally built as a Python terminal program for CS50P. The browser adaptation preserves the letter matching, difficulty settings, and two-second mismatch reveal.
